title: Integration event envelope, version 1
description: The self-contained body of every integration event (ADR-023 section 4). It validates the envelope only: 'payload' is validated separately by the schema of (producer, eventType, eventVersion), at schemas/<producer>/<eventType>.v<eventVersion>.schema.json. The envelope is versioned independently of eventVersion and changes only additively; a breaking envelope change requires a new topic.

eventId.description: The identity of the logical business fact (GUID version 7), not of an individual serialized message, and the consumers' deduplication key. Every message stating the same fact carries it: redeliveries and the versions of a dual publication. A message is identified by (eventId, eventVersion).

eventType.description: Past-tense PascalCase event name, unique within the producer.

eventVersion.description: The version of the payload contract of (producer, eventType): its major version. It versions neither the envelope nor the aggregate's state.

publishedVersions.description: The versions in which the producer publishes this fact, identical in every message of the fact: [1] for a single version, [1, 2] during a dual publication. It must contain eventVersion (a message where it does not is malformed). Consumers select one version per fact from it and their own declaration, independent of arrival order.

aggregateId.description: The aggregate the fact is about.

tenantId.description: The tenant the message belongs to; null only for messages that are not tenant-scoped.

occurredAtUtc.description: Business time of the fact, ISO-8601 in UTC with a trailing Z.

causationId.description: The eventId of the causing message, or the correlation ID of the HTTP request that caused a root message.

payload.description: The event-specific data, validated by the schema of (producer, eventType, eventVersion).
